---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the use case. What is hard or impossible to do today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like Jacer to do. Mock-ups or rough sketches welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've thought about solving this.

## Scope check

Jacer is deliberately narrow. Before submitting, check whether this fits:

- [ ] It serves the routine-template loop (weekly/fortnightly templates, prepopulation, lock/unlock)
- [ ] It serves the day-planning loop (Today / Backlog / Scheduled, duration estimates, day-total cap)
- [ ] Neither — but I think there's still a strong case (explain below)

Features outside the two core loops are usually deferred to the `v0.2-backlog` discussion.
